description: Unit test class for LogUtil utility functions in the Akka-based logging system, specifically testing enhancement of log MDC with correlation IDs and custom fields.

classes.name: LogUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing LogUtil's log enhancement methods.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Initializes default MDC map with known key-value pairs before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up a mocked DiagnosticLoggingAdapter with default MDC before each test.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests the method that adds or updates the correlation ID in the log's MDC.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdRemovesEmptyId
methods.description: Verifies that the correlation ID is removed when passing null.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndAdditionalMdcField
methods.description: Tests adding correlation ID along with an additional MDC field.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomField
methods.description: Tests adding a custom field to log MDC.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomFieldRemovesNullField
methods.description: Verifies removing a custom field when null is provided.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomFieldRemovesEmptyField
methods.description: Verifies removing a custom field when an empty string is provided.

methods.name: removeCustomField
methods.description: Tests removal of a custom field from MDC.

methods.name: newMdcField
methods.description: Tests creation of a new MdcField object with specified name and value.
